post.description: OCR_REVIEW sets stored document OCR status to REVIEW_REQUIRED. OCR_REVIEW to KYC_REVIEW requires private media readiness, an independently resolved OCR result bound to tenant, country, vendor, exact document set and locked document revision, plus independent KYC attestation. Only then are documents marked VERIFIED. Approval revalidates KYC and bank proofs. Unconfigured or rejected provider results leave application revision, state and document statuses unchanged; real provider configuration is deployment dependent.
